dedupe_keys.name: cropsuite open source crop suitability model

description: An open-source model that rates how suitable land is for crops under current and future climate. The Zenodo record for version 1.5.6 (28 October 2025) says CropSuite combines climate, soil and elevation data with fuzzy logic membership functions to give continuous suitability scores for many crops, accounts for year-to-year climate variability, and computes optimal sowing dates, including for multiple cropping. It has a graphical user interface, a built-in data viewer, flexible input and output resolutions, and .ini configuration files. The package (a 365 MB zip) is free to download under CC BY-SA 4.0. Coverage is any region with the user's input data. Caveats: it is an empirical model, and the page read does not name the language or bundled datasets. For simulation it shows how climate change shifts crop suitability and sowing windows, for agricultural adaptation planning. A related catalogue record is the potentially cultivable land dataset by the same group.
